dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: Right? Finches are the cutest! Hee-hee, you get it too!

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: Then make sure you stop by Sister Maiskaya's later, okay? Bing-Bang Finchball is really fun!

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: Oh, and don't be scared of Sister Maiskaya, okay? She looks kind of scary at first, but she's super nice.

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: I got nervous the first time I went to play, too. I saw her face and thought, "Did I do something bad? Did I put something in the wrong place?"

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: Then Sister Maiskaya came over with her serious face on and said, "You did really good. Here, this is your prize."

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: Then she pulled a bunch of Finchball plushies out of her pocket and let me choose my favorite...

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: Bye-bye! Mm... Maybe I should go play some Finchball too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That was really nice of her...

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: Yeah! After I picked mine, I gave her a really, really serious thank-you.

dialogues.speaker: Shatskaya
dialogues.text: You should say thank you when you go play too, okay? She'll be so happy.
